name: Luceria von Diamante
original_name: ルセリア・フォン・ディアマンテ
source:
Princess of Edellant Kingdom.

Princess of the Kingdom of Edellant, Luceria is a kind but sheltered girl who has lived an uneventful life in Shoenburg Castle without any friends besides Emeralia. Famous for having the largest bust in the kingdom.

She develops a crush on Lute after he resolves the civil war & adamantly protects Luceria's "big sis" Gladys from harsh punishment. They begin a romantic relationship when Lute is assigned as her sword instructor.

Becomes Lute's third queen.
